mapper.sql: select m.member_id, m.phone, m.password, m.invite_code, m.parent_id, m.ancestors, m.real_name, m.id_card, m.kyc_status, m.level_id, l.level_name, m.status, m.ga_secret, m.ga_status, m.create_by, m.create_time, m.update_by, m.update_time, m.remark, (select w.available from biz_wallet w where w.member_id = m.member_id and w.currency = 'CNY') as cny_available, (select w.frozen from biz_wallet w where w.member_id = m.member_id and w.currency = 'CNY') as cny_frozen, (select w.available from biz_wallet w where w.member_id = m.member_id and w.currency = 'USDT') as usdt_available, (select w.frozen from biz_wallet w where w.member_id = m.member_id and w.currency = 'USDT') as usdt_frozen, (select count(1) from biz_member t where find_in_set(m.member_id, t.ancestors)) as team_count from biz_member m left join biz_level l on l.level_id = m.level_id
mapper.select: select count(1) from biz_member m where find_in_set(#{memberId}, m.ancestors) and m.kyc_status = '1' and exists (select 1 from biz_order o where o.member_id = m.member_id)
select count(1) from biz_member where parent_id = #{memberId}

and m.parent_id = #{memberId}
and m.parent_id in (select member_id from biz_member where parent_id = #{memberId})
and m.parent_id in ( select member_id from biz_member where parent_id in (select member_id from biz_member where parent_id = #{memberId}) )
and find_in_set(#{memberId}, m.ancestors)
order by m.member_id desc
